author: raman118
body:
#### References to other Issues or PRs

Fixes #27439. Follows the constructor-level approach requested in #27488.

#### Brief description of what is fixed or changed

`Vector(a, b, c)` currently creates an invalid object that raises `RecursionError` during scalar multiplication. Direct `Vector(...)` construction now raises `TypeError` with guidance to use `CoordSys3D` basis vectors. Subclass construction remains supported.

#### Other comments

Regression failed before the fix. Validation: vector suite (121 passed, 2 xfailed), vector argument tests (7 passed), code-quality tests (6 passed), Ruff, and `bin/mailmap_check.py` passed.

#### AI Generation Disclosure

OpenAI Codex (GPT-6 Astra) generated all changes in `sympy/vector/vector.py`, `sympy/vector/tests/test_vector.py`, and `.mailmap`. This PR description was also written by the AI agent at the account owner's request.

#### Release Notes

<!-- BEGIN RELEASE NOTES -->
* vector
  * Direct construction of `Vector` now raises a helpful `TypeError` instead of creating an invalid object that can cause infinite recursion during scalar multiplication.
<!-- END RELEASE NOTES -->

linked.body:
#### References to other Issues or PRs  
Fixes #27439  

#### Brief description of what is fixed or changed  
This PR addresses a bug where incorrectly defining a `Vector` caused an infinite recursion error.  
The correct way to define a vector is documented in the [[SymPy documentation](https://docs.sympy.org/latest/modules/vector/basics.html#coordinate-systems-and-vectors)](https://docs.sympy.org/latest/modules/vector/basics.html#coordinate-systems-and-vectors), as highlighted by @oscarbenjamin in [[this comment](https://github.com/sympy/sympy/issues/27439#issuecomment-2571602853)](https://github.com/sympy/sympy/issues/27439#issuecomment-2571602853).  

A regression test has been added to ensure this issue does not reoccur.  

#### Other comments  
Feedback and constructive criticism are highly appreciated! I am currently learning about SymPy and its codebase by tackling issues I can contribute to.  

#### Release Notes  

<!-- BEGIN RELEASE NOTES -->  
* vector  
  * Fixed a bug where incorrectly defining vectors caused an infinite recursion error.  
<!-- END RELEASE NOTES -->
linked.title: Fix infinite recursion error when vectors are defined incorrectly
